latestAction.text: Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S4511; text: CR S4508)

summary.text: This resolution designates June 23, 2025, as Social Media Harms Victim Remembrance Day and encourages government, industry, and community stakeholders to take action to prevent social media-related harm.

title: A resolution designating June 23, 2025, as "Social Media Harms Victim Remembrance Day".
